title: Saudian Lamb Kebabs with German Flair
description: A unique fusion of Arabian and German cuisines, these lamb kebabs are marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yellow, spiced, arabian, and saudi.
Add lamb to the bowl and mix well to coat.
Thread lamb onto kebabs, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches 63°C (145°F) for medium-rare.
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
